user_query: Under Section 4(1)(b) of the RTI Act, what organisational functions, budget allocations and subsidy programmes is the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances required to publish proactively on its website?
ai_response:
As a statutory RTI Assistant, I can provide you with the answer based on the retrieved context.

Section 4(1)(b) of the Right to Information Act, 2005 (RTI Act) requires the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) to publish proactively on its website:

"...the particulars of its organization, functions and duties; powers and responsibilities; procedural details as to how difficulties are addressed or resolved; budget allocated and subsidies provided."

Source: Section 4(1)(b), Right to Information Act, 2005.

This information is required to be published proactively by the DARPG on its website, as part of its statutory obligations under the RTI Act.
